title: ze_prey_bedroom
description:
Hola,

This is a beta version of prey_bedroom, it was originally created for the MAPEADORES game mode PREY. I ported the whole prey system to work on a zombie escape server.
Humans can grab props by pressing E, place them, and heal them by knifing them.
Zombies can pick a race by using !zmclass, and have to knife the props and the humans.

Survive 4 minutes and then you'll have to face the zombies!!

Ideal for low population servers !

Let me know if you find any issue
